scope: One fixed-cell GFN2 pilot geometry; not energetic, numerical sampling, DFT, experimental, or global-minimum validation
coordinate_convention: Fixed atom identity; optimization positions unwrapped; original covalent image shifts retained

displacement.definition: sqrt(mean of squared per-atom minimum-image displacement norms), no rotation, translation, permutation, or chain alignment

hydrogen_bond_changes.role: Threshold-based post-run geometry diagnostic; not measured hydrogen bonds or an acceptance criterion

valence_geometry.role: declared broad geometric screens, not literature-derived geometry or optimized minima

declared_symmetry.interpretation: Species-preserving global bijection per declared operation; no chain-wise alignment

hydrogen_bonds.criterion_role: optional geometric diagnostic only; never an admission rule or measured bond assignment
hydrogen_bonds.analysis_role: Post-optimization diagnostic only; never used for seed admission, selection, ranking, or convergence

hydrogen_bond_sheet_topology.interpretation: Two infinite ac-connected sheets under the declared broad H-bond graph criterion; not measured or optimized connectivity
